entry.sample_type: magnetically enriched CD3 positive T cells from single cell suspensions

evidence.quote: At indicated time points, we performed intercellular staining of NME1 (11615-H07E; Sino Biological) using a Foxp3/Transcription Factor Staining Buffer Kit (Tonbo Biosciences) for fixation and permeabilization of cells according to manufacturer’s instructions.
